title: STNFS with 99.9% ECM, theta = 207/500 and a unit-entry LA kernel: 121.8936

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the numerical refinement and plan re-optimisation in REFINEMENT.md the 99.9% ECM / theta = 207/500 relation-collection revision (proof.md) and the unit-entry linear-algebra kernel in STORAGE.md (unit-entry kernel section) returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.391918 (and hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (with H4u: at least 88% of the filtered matrix row weight is +-1 entries). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^121.8936 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents, C=20,000 instructions, with an upper-rounded complete ledger <= 2^121.89358. Main-phase ECM succeeds with 99.9% per prime, the collected region is theta=207/500 (1378 canonical rows, a-radius 931) with cofactor slacks (300, 228) and work allowance 1.0588, and relation collection is <= 2^121.4690 units. The polynomials, factor-base bound, filtering, kernels and target remain those of the cited source; eight descent-plan entries are re-optimised at the refined quadrature (REFINEMENT.md). Linear algebra charges 71 instructions per sparse entry (+-1 entries by the 11-instruction add loop of la_mac.s (_group_run), others by the 33-instruction loop, unit fraction charged at 0.88) with Block Wiedemann blocks (22, 4): <= 2^119.1608 units, generator <= 2^106.1537. Nested lower sums use384 cells, rho brackets use1/1024, iA indices scale by8, TRUNC=0, and retention uses the same global mesh. Expected two-log work is bounded by 2^117.9122; the two-log meter is 2^118.635; Markov abort probability is <= 0.6059204. Other upper bounds are boot failure 1.7864e-4 per log, expected nodes 2^17.60, node abort 2^-9.70 and repeats 2^-10.70, with2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failed attempts, advice construction, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing is amortized over other targets. Numerical-certificate construction receives an extra2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most2^105 bytes. The source smoothness and production extrapolations remain explicit heuristics; no favorable finite-density correction or unsupported independence of whole logarithms is asserted. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) to mean weight 100 and measure the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries, against the charged 0.88. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u).
Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger, retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 30 s natively; longer when emulated).
